  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

  •  Increases blast radius

  •  Increases projectile speed

  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Sticky Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon attach on impact and detonate when enemies are in proximity.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Shield Disorient
perks.desc: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

notes: [YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Velocity] "Berenger's could see some usage should we ever return to a Heavy Grenade Launcher PvE Meta - with a myriad of ways to either overfill (Clown Cartridge) or auto-reload (ALH, Pulse Monitor, Demolitionist), with the right perks, you could stand and fire 18 shots in a row without manually reloading or stowing your weapon once. [Clown+Backup Mag/Demolitionist] Aim for Spike Grenades, which are a 50% buff to impact damage." tags:pve
